lines.en: label springend5:
scene back2class1
There is no warm welcome when I make it back to class, but I’d be lying if I said I expected one.
lines.zh: 当我回到教室时，并没有热烈的欢迎，但如果我说我早有期待，那就是在撒谎。

lines.en: There’s no welcome at all, come to think of it. But there {i}is{/i} silence in the classroom for the first time since I was reborn here. So at least there’s that to think about.
lines.zh: 想想看，根本就没有任何欢迎。但教室里{i}确实{/i}一片寂静，这还是我重生于此以来第一次。所以起码还有这一点值得琢磨。

lines.en: In a sense though, maybe this silence {i}is{/i} my welcome?
lines.zh: 不过从某种意义上说，也许这片寂静{i}就是{/i}给我的欢迎？

lines.en: Maybe it’s what I get after {b}ABANDONING{/b} these girls the same way I {b}ABANDONED{/b} her.
lines.zh: 也许这就是我{b}抛弃{/b}了这些女孩之后应得的下场，就像我{b}抛弃{/b}了她一样。

lines.en: Maybe I should line them up and fuck them into oblivion right here and now before throwing myself off the roof of this building and starting over from scratch.
lines.zh: 也许我该现在就让她们排成一排，操到她们神志全无，然后再从这栋楼的天台跳下去，从头再来。

lines.en: I keep thinking I might see her again if I do. But I’m unable to think about it for very long as the pungent stench of a nearby rotting meat puppet is rather distracting and out of place.
lines.zh: 我总想着，如果这么做，说不定就能再见到她。但我没法想太久，因为近旁那具腐坏的肉身傀儡散发出的刺鼻恶臭实在太让人分神，而且格格不入。

lines.en: These are my girls.
lines.zh: 这些是我的女孩们。

lines.en: This is my class.
lines.zh: 这是我的班级。

lines.en: This is where I stand when I “teach” class.
lines.zh: 这就是我「授课」时所站的地方。

lines.en: But unlike the beginning of this so-called life, my motivation has been shot. And those once-ulterior motives of mine can no longer be called “motives” at all.
lines.zh: 但与这段所谓人生的开端不同，我的动力已经荡然无存。而我那些曾经不可告人的动机，如今再也不能被称为「动机」了。

lines.en: Now, they’re just impulses. Holes for me to hide in when predators begin to circle me, excitedly awaiting the perfect moment to swoop down and rip my head off of my body.
lines.zh: 现在，它们只是冲动。是当捕食者开始绕着我打转、兴奋地等待最佳时机扑下来把我的脑袋从脖子上扯掉时，供我藏身的洞穴。

lines.en: There’s a fleeting memory that creeps in as I stare down this ocean of unease.
lines.zh: 当我凝视这片不安的汪洋时，一段转瞬即逝的记忆悄然爬上心头。

lines.en: A hawk and a half-eaten squirrel.
lines.zh: 一只鹰，和一只被吃了一半的松鼠。

lines.en: The drops of blood that stained my summer uniform.
lines.zh: 还有那些染脏了我夏季校服的血滴。

lines.en: scene back2class2
I need to speak now.
lines.zh: 我必须现在开口。

lines.en: I need to tell them why I’m here.
lines.zh: 我必须告诉她们我为什么在这里。

lines.en: scene back2class3
: If anyone wants to yell at me, please do it now. But also note that Miss Watabe covered everything about how being here is my “responsibility” and how not doing that was kind of a dick move.
lines.zh: : 如果有谁想冲我吼，请现在就吼。不过也请注意，关于来这里是我的「责任」、以及不来有多混蛋这点，Watabe 老师已经替你们说尽了。

lines.en: Of course, no one responds. And my half-hearted attempt at a tongue-in-cheek introduction has done nothing but lay the groundwork for several oral blisters.
lines.zh: 当然，没有人回应。而我这场半心半意、嬉皮笑脸的开场白，唯一的成果就是为几个口腔溃疡打下了基础。

lines.en: However, as excited as I am to taste the fluid they conceal, I must save some of it or I won’t have anything left to spew all over these girls but the same liquid lifeline I so often squeeze out of my cock.
lines.zh: 不过，尽管我很想尝尝它们里面藏着的液体，我总得留一些，否则就只剩下那根我常从鸡巴里挤出来的、一模一样的液体生命线，可以喷这些女孩一身了。

lines.en: : Right. So, I guess I owe you all an explanation as to why I haven’t been here in two months. But apologies in advance since you likely all know just how bad I am at explaining things by now.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那么，我想我欠你们一个解释，说明为什么这两个月我都没来。不过先说声抱歉，因为你们大概早就知道我有多不擅长解释事情了。

lines.en: scene back2class4
: Without beating around the bush, I lost something I cared about. Something I...
lines.zh: : 不绕弯子了，我失去了某样我在乎的东西。某样我……

lines.en: : Something I loved. There’s no sense in dancing around it at this point. That’s how it was. That’s how it {i}is.{/i} And without it, I’m kind of hopeless. {i}More{/i} hopeless.
lines.zh: : 某样我爱过的东西。事到如今再遮遮掩掩也没意义了。当时就是那样。现在{i}也{/i}是这样。而没有它，我基本上是没救了。{i}更{/i}没救了。

lines.en: : Like...there’s no chance to improve or...{i}get better{/i} anymore. And any shot I had at that vanished along with the thing I lost.
lines.zh: : 就好像……再也没有好转或者……{i}变好{/i}的可能了。而我原本仅有的那点机会，也随着我失去的东西一起消失了。

lines.en: scene back2class5
: I’m not going to pretend I’m okay now or act like things are going to go back to normal. They’re not. And I owe it to all of you, who’ve been by my side this whole time, to be as truthful as I can.
lines.zh: : 我不会假装自己现在没事，也不会装作一切会回到正轨。不会的。而我对你们所有人——这一路都陪在我身边的人——欠下一份尽可能坦诚的交代。

lines.en: : The problem with that is I can only be {i}so{/i} truthful as lying is just part of my nature at this point. But I won’t embellish on that as it would only cause more problems and that’s not what I’m here to do.
lines.zh: : 问题在于，我能做到的坦诚也就{i}只有这么多{/i}，因为说谎在眼下已经成了我本性的一部分。但我不想在这上面多作渲染，那只会惹出更多麻烦，而我今天来不是为了这个。

lines.en: : I’ve spent the last two months in bed at home.
lines.zh: : 这两个月我一直躺在家里的床上。

lines.en: : Ami’s taken care of me the entire time and I don’t want any of you holding that against her as that’s what I would have {i}wanted{/i} her to do if I was...you know. Conscious.
lines.zh: : 一直是 Ami 在照顾我，我不希望你们任何人因此怪她，因为如果我……你知道的，还有意识的话，那也正是我{i}希望{/i}她去做的事。

lines.en: : And she did a great job, I think. Even if it meant disappointing or angering any of you who may have wanted to come visit me.
lines.zh: : 而且我觉得她做得很好。哪怕这意味着让你们当中想来看我的人失望或者生气。

lines.en: : Be happy you didn’t, though. And be happy you didn’t get to see me in whatever sorry state I was in because I highly doubt it’d be anything you’d {i}want{/i} to see.
lines.zh: : 不过你们该庆幸自己没来。也该庆幸没看到我当时那副狼狈样子，因为我很怀疑那会是你{i}想{/i}看到的东西。

lines.en: scene back2class2
: Wait, I got a question! That thing ya lost, what was it? There really ain’t no way for us to help you get it back?
lines.zh: : 等等，我有个问题！你失去的那个东西，是什么啊？我们真的就没办法帮你把它找回来吗？

lines.en: : Miku, let him finish.
lines.zh: : Miku，让他说完。

lines.en: : No, Miku’s right. If you’re going to try to be as “truthful as you can,” can’t you give us that much?
lines.zh: : 不，Miku 说得对。既然你打算「尽可能坦诚」，那这点总该告诉我们吧？

lines.en: : If I didn’t know any better, I’d say he was referring to a lover of some sort. But it appears that everyone he’d ever rightfully consider as a candidate for {i}love{/i} is here in this very room.
lines.zh: : 要不是我清楚内情，我倒会以为他说的是某个恋人。可看起来，他有资格称之为{i}爱{/i}的候选人，此刻全都在这一间屋子里。

lines.en: : I’m not going to tell you what it was since it would make me sound insane — which you’re probably all thinking right now anyway-
lines.zh: : 我不会告诉你们那是什么，因为那会让我听起来像个疯子——反正你们现在多半也正这么想——

lines.en: : Not at all! None of us hold this against you, Sensei! We were...we were just worried!
lines.zh: : 完全没有！我们没有一个人会怪你，Sensei！我们只是……我们只是很担心！

lines.en: : Yeah, even {i}I{/i} was thinking about breaking into your house like dorm 7 did.
lines.zh: : 是啊，就连{i}我{/i}都在琢磨着，要像 7 号宿舍那样闯进你家去。

lines.en: : Wait, what? There was a break-in and I wasn’t invited?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？有人闯空门而我没被邀请？

lines.en: : {i}Io! You told her?!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Io！你告诉她了？！{/i}

lines.en: : It came up naturally.
lines.zh: : 是自然聊到的嘛。

lines.en: : Io, what the fuck?!
lines.zh: : Io，你他妈的？！

lines.en: : What? Do you seriously think I’d invite {i}you{/i} to any-
lines.zh: : 什么？你真以为我会邀请{i}你{/i}参加什么——

lines.en: : Hey! Quiet down. You’ll all have plenty of time to talk once Sensei’s done filling you in on his situation.
lines.zh: : 嘿！安静点。等 Sensei 把情况跟你们说完，你们有的是时间聊。

lines.en: : Go ahead, Senpai. If they interrupt you again, I’ll start cracking domes.
lines.zh: : 继续吧，前辈。要是她们再打断你，我就开始敲脑壳了。

lines.en: : Thanks, Imani.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Imani。

lines.en: scene back2class3
: Fortunately, I don’t have much left in terms of “filling you all in.” I’ve just regained some amount of sentience and figured I should let you all know I’m alive so you don’t have to worry anymore.
lines.zh: : 幸运的是，要说「把情况交代清楚」，我也没剩多少可说的了。我只是恢复了一点知觉，觉得该让你们知道我还活着，这样你们就不用再担心了。

lines.en: : So we don’t have to worry?...Do you seriously think this is going to make us {i}stop{/i} worrying about you?
lines.zh: : 这样我们就不用再担心了？……你真觉得这样我们就能{i}停止{/i}担心你吗？

lines.en: : If I can add something here...I do believe this does more harm than good in that regard, Sensei. {i}Alive{/i} as you may be, you still seem rather...shell-shocked, to say the least.
lines.zh: : 我能不能插一句……我认为就这一点而言，这样做弊大于利，Sensei。{i}活着{/i}是活着，可你看起来依然相当……往轻了说，是惊魂未定。

lines.en: : To say the most, it is my belief that you look even uglier than normal, bro.
lines.zh: : 往重了说，我认为你看起来比平时还要丑，老兄。

lines.en: : Thank you, Tsuneyo. And Touka. And Rin. And all of you.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你们，Tsuneyo。还有 Touka。还有 Rin。还有你们所有人。

lines.en: scene back2class6
: Perhaps saying that you won’t have to worry anymore was putting it a little too lightly. I’m well aware of how I look right now and how...different this is from the way I normally “handle” things.
lines.zh: : 也许说「你们不用再担心了」确实说得太轻巧了。我很清楚自己现在是什么样子，也很清楚这跟我平时「应付」事情的方式有多……不一样。

lines.en: : I just don’t know what else to do anymore now that I’ve lost the one bit of hope I had left.
lines.zh: : 我只是不知道还能做什么了，如今我连最后剩下的一点希望都失去了。

lines.en: : There’s more...you {i}know{/i} there’s more! You’ve come back from this before! And you’ve got us here to help you this time!
lines.zh: : 还有别的……你{i}明明知道{/i}还有别的！你以前从这种状态里走出来过！而且这一次你有我们在这里帮你！

lines.en: : The psion preaches truth, Sir! You have my axe! And anything else you may want- including (but not limited to) a frail Irish shoulder to cry on.
lines.zh: : 这位灵能者所言极是，先生！我的斧头归你了！还有你可能想要的任何东西——包括（但不限于）一副单薄的爱尔兰肩膀供你哭泣。

lines.en: : Again, thank you. I’m sorry for how depressing this all sounds and how...{i}childish{/i} it must seem for a grown man to basically cry about his problems in front of an entire classroom.
lines.zh: : 再次谢谢你们。很抱歉这些话听起来这么丧，而且一个成年男人当着全班的面哭诉自己的问题，想必有{i}多幼稚{/i}。

lines.en: scene back2class7
: I just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: : I think I need some time away from this.
lines.zh: : 我想我需要离开这些，静一静。

lines.en: : I don’t want to be here anymore.
lines.zh: : 我不想再待在这里了。

lines.en: : As in...as in you’re quitting? You’re not going to be our teacher anymore?
lines.zh: : 意思是……意思是你要辞职？你不再当我们的老师了？

lines.en: : To be fair, was he ever?
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，他当过吗？

lines.en: : Fuck off, Yumi! Sensei’s in pain right now and hitting him while he’s down is-
lines.zh: : 滚开，Yumi！Sensei 现在正痛苦，落井下石这种事——

lines.en: : Easy, deerfucker. You tryin’ to arm wrestle again?
lines.zh: : 悠着点，操鹿的家伙。你又想比掰腕子了？

lines.en: : Enough! Both of you!
lines.zh: : 够了！你们两个！

lines.en: : I’m not {i}quitting.{/i} I just...
lines.zh: : 我不是要{i}辞职{/i}。我只是……

lines.en: : I’m not ready to come back yet.
lines.zh: : 我还没准备好回来。

lines.en: : So I guess I should throw an apology to Imani in here as well since I’ll be asking her to keep covering for me until I feel more...human.
lines.zh: : 那么我想，我也该在这里向 Imani 道个歉，因为接下来我还要请她继续替我顶班，直到我感觉自己更……像个人。

lines.en: : Can we, like...still hang out with you, at least? {i}Outside{/i} of school.
lines.zh: : 那我们……至少还能和你一起玩吧？{i}在{/i}学校之外。

lines.en: : Maybe. I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。我不知道。

lines.en: : I’ll come find you if I want to see you. Just don’t expect too much from me since I have nothing left to give.
lines.zh: : 如果我想见你们，我会去找你们的。只是别对我期望太高，因为我已经没有什么可以给出的了。

lines.en: I pause, half-expecting the silence to disappear in favor of uncertain whispers or anxious mumbles, but all eyes remain on me while {i}my{/i} eyes remain on the floor.
lines.zh: 我停顿下来，本以为这片寂静会被迟疑的低语或不安的嘟囔取代，可所有的目光都还落在我身上，而{i}我{/i}的目光仍停在地板上。

lines.en: My irises have grown far too heavy to lift any further than this. And despite how much I want to hide them in the depths of forty others, I simply can’t move.
lines.zh: 我的眼珠已经沉重得再也抬不起分毫。尽管我多么想把它们藏进另外四十双眼睛的深处，我却根本动弹不得。

lines.en: If you could see the world through my eyes...right now, all you’d see is shame and guilt, twisted into the shape of a chalk outline on a blue-tiled floor.
lines.zh: 如果你能透过我的眼睛看这个世界……此刻你能看见的，只有羞耻与愧疚，被扭成蓝色瓷砖地板上一具粉笔勾勒的轮廓。

lines.en: You’d see my shadow. And if you inherited my present state-of-mind, you’d perceive it as a monster. Something you need to run away from.
lines.zh: 你会看见我的影子。而如果你继承了我此刻的心境，你会把它看成一头怪物。一个你必须逃离的东西。

lines.en: But your legs would lock like a fainting goat. Then, you’d wait to be devoured.
lines.zh: 可你的双腿会像昏倒的山羊一样僵住。然后，你会等着被吞噬。

lines.en: Maybe that rotting stench of meat has been me all along. And maybe this class will turn to vultures and pick me clean like the detritivores they are.
lines.zh: 也许那股腐肉的恶臭从头到尾就是我自己的。也许这个班会变成一群秃鹫，像它们本来的食腐本性那样，把我啄食干净。

lines.en: Every one of us is a scavenger. And it isn’t long until someone here makes the first move and the true colors of our rapidly fading rainbow will finally be revealed.
lines.zh: 我们每一个都是食腐者。用不了多久，这里就会有谁先动手，而我们那道迅速褪色的彩虹，真正的颜色终于要显现了。

lines.en: If life is like a work of art, let my body be the brush.
lines.zh: 如果人生是一幅艺术品，那就让我的身体成为那支画笔。

lines.en: May I be dunked in lead-based paint and dragged across the canvas until I’m stiff and worthless and dropped into a trash bag.
lines.zh: 愿我被浸进含铅的颜料，被拖过画布，直到僵硬、一文不值，然后被丢进垃圾袋。

lines.en: I hope Heaven is a pile of waste so that I may once more catch a glimpse of all the bitter fruit I discarded.
lines.zh: 我希望天堂是一堆废弃物，好让我能再看一眼那些被我丢弃的苦涩果实。

lines.en: I hope the enzymes from her decayed carcass destroy my technicolor crust and reunite us beneath a mountain of tissues and maggots and everything in between.
lines.zh: 我希望她那具腐烂的躯体所渗出的酶，能毁掉我这层彩色硬壳，让我们在一堆纸巾与蛆虫、以及介于两者之间的一切之下重逢。

lines.en: I hope this is the last time I am hurt.
lines.zh: 我希望这是最后一次受伤。

lines.en: But if there is anything I know about God and Its awful plan, it’s that it won’t be.
lines.zh: 但如果说我对上帝和它那套糟糕的计划还有什么了解，那就是：不会的。

lines.en: It’s that I have much more hurting to do.
lines.zh: 那就是：我还要受更多的伤。

lines.en: : My lamb...
lines.zh: : 我的羔羊……

lines.en: : He has returned...
lines.zh: : 他回来了……

lines.en: : Touka, come get your girl. I have too many questions about what the hell that could possibly mean.
lines.zh: : Touka，来把你家姑娘领走。关于这到底是什么意思，我有一大堆问题要问。

lines.en: : I also have a question!
lines.zh: : 我也有个问题！

lines.en: scene back2class8
: Well, I guess it’d be more accurate to say it’s not a question. Just a thing I want to mention in regard to my uncle’s situation.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我想更准确地说，那不是问题。只是关于我舅舅的处境，我想提一件事。

lines.en: : So...Sensei! If it’s okay, may I have a word with the class next?
lines.zh: : 那么……Sensei！如果可以的话，接下来能让我跟全班说几句话吗？

lines.en: : I don’t...know if that’s the best idea, Ami.
lines.zh: : 我不……确定这是不是个好主意，Ami。

lines.en: : Why? You’re not insinuating that I’ve been going crazy, are you? Just look at my adorable smile! I’m more than capable of talking to all of my friends without saying anything rash or mean!
lines.zh: : 为什么？你该不是在暗示我最近疯了吧？看看我这可爱的笑容！我完全有能力在跟朋友们说话时不冒出任何鲁莽或刻薄的话！

lines.en: : Yeah, I don’t know if I believe that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我不知道自己信不信。

lines.en: : Maybe...wait until {i}after{/i} class is over, Ami?
lines.zh: : 要不……等到{i}下课之后{/i}再说，Ami？

lines.en: : Nobody will listen to me {i}after{/i} class, Uta! Besides, you should hear this speech too! Like, really! Before you lose even more of my trust!
lines.zh: : {i}下课之后{/i}没人会听我说话的，Uta！再说了，这段演讲你也该听听！真的！趁你还没把我的信任丢得更多！

lines.en: : Ami...don’t.
lines.zh: : Ami……别。

lines.en: scene back2class9
: Don’t what? I haven’t done anything yet.
lines.zh: : 别什么？我还没做什么呢。

lines.en: : Just don’t...please...
lines.zh: : 就是别……拜托……

lines.en: : Boy, you sure are {i}weird{/i} today, Ayane!
lines.zh: : 哎呀，你今天可真{i}奇怪{/i}啊，Ayane！

lines.en: scene back2class10
: Sensei! May I speak now?
lines.zh: : Sensei！我现在能说了吗？

lines.en: scene back2class11
: Great! Thanks for yielding the floor to me!
lines.zh: : 太好了！谢谢把发言权让给我！

lines.en: : {i}Senpai...you sure this is okay? Doesn’t she seem a little...off to you?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}前辈……你确定这样没问题吗？她看起来是不是有点……不太对劲？{/i}

lines.en: : Huh?...What?...

lines.zh: : Ami？……

lines.en: scene back2class12
: Hi, everybody! My name’s Ami Arakawa, but most of you probably know that already!
lines.zh: : 大家好！我叫 Ami Arakawa，不过你们大多数人大概早就知道了！

lines.en: : My interests include my uncle, cooking for my uncle, cleaning my uncle’s room, washing my uncle’s clothes, and talking about my uncle!
lines.zh: : 我的兴趣包括我舅舅、给我舅舅做饭、打扫我舅舅的房间、洗我舅舅的衣服，还有谈论我舅舅！

lines.en: : Bitch just described half the god damn class.
lines.zh: : 这婊子刚刚描述了这个破班一半的人。

lines.en: : Hahaha! I really did, didn’t I? And I’m glad you mentioned that, Yumi! Because that’s kind of what I wanted to talk to you guys about!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈！我确实说中了，对吧？Yumi，我很高兴你提到这点！因为那正好是我想跟你们聊的事！

lines.en: scene back2class11
: As you can see, Sensei’s fallen on some pretty tough times recently. And his mental health has taken a real turn for the worse!
lines.zh: : 正如你们所见，Sensei 最近遭遇了相当艰难的处境。而他的精神状态也确实急转直下！

lines.en: : And while I’m sure there are many of you who are suuuuuuuper-duper worried about that, you should probably just leave him alone!
lines.zh: : 虽然我肯定你们当中有很多人对此超——级——无敌担心，但你们大概还是别去烦他比较好！

lines.en: : And by “probably” I mean you should {i}definitely{/i} leave him alone because A — you don’t get it. And B — you just want him to fuck your silly little brains out! Teehee!
lines.zh: : 而且我说的「大概」，意思是你们{i}绝对{/i}该离他远点，因为第一——你们根本不懂。第二——你们只是想让他把你们那蠢蠢的小脑袋操到开花！嘻嘻！

lines.en: scene back2class13
: Oh! Is something wrong, [[REDACTED]?
lines.zh: : 哦！有什么不对劲吗，[[REDACTED]？

lines.en: : Nope...just hit my knee on the desk.
lines.zh: : 没有……只是膝盖撞到桌子了。

lines.en: : Wow! It sounded pretty painful! Maybe you should go to the nurse’s office and make sure it’s not broken.
lines.zh: : 哇！听起来挺疼的！也许你该去趟保健室，确认一下没摔断。

lines.en: scene back2class14
: Good idea. I’ll do that right now.
lines.zh: : 好主意。我现在就去。

lines.en: : Okaaaaay! See you later! Hope your “knee” is okay!
lines.zh: : 好——的！回头见！希望你的「膝盖」没事！

lines.en: : {i}I knew it...I fucking knew it...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我就知道……我他妈的就知道……{/i}

lines.en: scene back2class15
: Listen, Ami. I’m gonna take it easy since I know the past couple months haven’t exactly been a cake-walk for {i}you{/i} either, but you can’t say shit like that in school. Ever. Don’t do it again.
lines.zh: : 听着，Ami。我尽量不跟你计较，因为我知道过去这两个月对{i}你{/i}来说也绝不是什么轻松的事，但你不能在学校里说这种话。永远不行。别再有下次了。

lines.en: : Are you saying that because you’re a teacher and it’s your {i}job{/i} to say it? Or because you just don’t like the thought of him having sex with anyone who isn’t you?
lines.zh: : 你这么说，是因为你是老师、说这话是你的{i}职责{/i}？还是因为你就是不喜欢想到他和除了你以外的任何人上床？

lines.en: : Oh, this fucking-
lines.zh: : 哦，这他妈的——

lines.en: : Imani, wait.
lines.zh: : Imani，等等。

lines.en: : Wait?! The hell you mean, “wait?!” Did you hear what she just said to me?!
lines.zh: : 等等？！「等等」是什么意思？！你听到她刚才对我说了什么吗？！

lines.en: : I can handle this.
lines.zh: : 我能处理。

lines.en: : Ami, go home. Now.
lines.zh: : Ami，回家去。现在。

lines.en: scene back2class16
: No!
lines.zh: : 不要！

lines.en: : Wow! Great job, Senpai! You really showed her!
lines.zh: : 哇！干得漂亮，前辈！你真给她点颜色看了！

lines.en: : Ami, I mean it. Go. Home. Before you make things even worse.
lines.zh: : Ami，我是认真的。回去。回家。趁你还没把事情弄得更糟。

lines.en: scene back2class17

: No thanks! I need to make sure that {i}everybody{/i} here knows that you have {i}no{/i} interest in them whatsoever and that any affection you ever showed to {i}any{/i} of them was all out of pity or obligation!
lines.zh: : 不用了！我必须让这里的{i}每一个人都{/i}搞清楚，你对她们{i}一点{/i}兴趣也没有，你曾经对{i}任何{/i}一个人表现出的所有柔情，统统只是出于怜悯或义务！

lines.en: : I understand that he’s super handsome and charismatic and smart and funny and hot and awesome and that those qualities might make it {i}impossible{/i} to stay away from him, but figure it out!
lines.zh: : 我明白，他超级帅气、有魅力、聪明、风趣、性感又了不起，而这些品质也许会让你{i}根本没法{/i}离他远点，可你们自己想办法解决！

lines.en: : Because if I find out that any of you so much as lay a {i}finger{/i} on him from this point on, I will strangle you with your own organs! Do you understand? Thank you!
lines.zh: : 因为如果我发现在这之后，你们当中有人敢对他动{i}一根手指{/i}，我就用你们自己的内脏把你们勒死！听懂了吗？谢谢！
